releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.ActivityPubOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to ActivityPub -- the W3C-standard federated social protocol powering the Fediverse (Mastodon, Lemmy, Pixelfed, and more). Publishes OASIS avatar activities, holon updates, and karma events as ActivityPub objects, enabling OASIS data to flow across the open social web. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add native Mastodon status-point CQL and verified developer walkthrough (9fbde0e)
- Add verified native ActivityPub public timeline pages (fb3383e)
- Bind ActivityPub transport to a validated origin and reject redirects (697f3e3)
- feat: implement native Mastodon explicit status batches (f537d2c)
- feat(activitypub): map native status reads and verify public live data (f0744ca)
- fix: classify ActivityPub social capabilities and acknowledge account reads (3a050bd)
- fix: implement truthful native ActivityPub account batches (cedea27)
- fix(activitypub): map native account reads to explicit public profiles (91a7fd5)
- fix(activitypub): own search scope and report completed selection (4222468)
- fix(activitypub): prevent generic holon storage from publishing records (f7c06ea)
- fix(activitypub): prevent private avatar saves creating remote accounts (83d4dcb)
- fix(activitypub): reject invented generic account deletion routes (fa67b15)
- fix(activitypub): report completed native status and reply reads as loaded (552d81a)
- fix(activitypub): retain reusable transport and truthful lifecycle state (1dd3a07)
- fix(activitypub): reuse native profile reader for separate avatar details (394d45f)
- fix(activitypub): validate explicit Mastodon v2 instance contract (1a87b60)
- Implement acknowledged native ActivityPub status deletion with reconciliation (3f067a9)
- Implement native Mastodon reply graph reads using shared projection (c6bb41a)
- Implement paged ActivityPub account and mixed-domain search (86f2d33)
- Integrate verified Mastodon search and deletion (60e51d9)
- Native import: Azure Cosmos, SOLID, ActivityPub, IPFS and Solana readers; STAR CLI nativeimport and cql commands; docs (fc85a95)
- Native import: bring your own connection (provider, API and test changes) (8717f37)
- Native import: the other five readers take a caller connection; stateless readers for connections; guarded HTTP handler; pin Core and STAR ODK (29dcbf9)
- Prevent private email disclosure through ActivityPub public search (2469eff)
- Read Mastodon parent replies by native status identity (8404dfc)
- Repair ActivityPub native search grouping pagination and public author linkage (315ed7b)
- Reuse strict native ActivityPub status projection (b54bfba)
- Ship scoped hosted CQL source discovery and ActivityPub query examples (0f4ee31)
- Stop treating ActivityPub projection GUIDs as native identities (805b29c)
- Verify synchronous public Mastodon reads without caller context (c6ee7ed)
